description: Only the runtimes bundled in the node package (ADR-0028). Their sha256 sums sit next to the versions in ci.yml and must be updated by hand in the bump PR.
prBodyNotes: Update the matching `*_SHA256_AMD64` and `*_SHA256_ARM64` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` before merging; the release build fails on a mismatch.
